sources.snippet: A router between a small and a large language model for multi-hop questions. It is a 33M MiniLM cross-encoder fine-tuned from nano-jev v1.0. Given the question, the small model's passages and its answer, it returns P (large model): the probability that the large model should answer. sources.title: S1MB: comparing System One Decision Models across 100+ benchmarks
sources.snippet: Since TypeSafe AI introduced Jev, its System One Decision Model, other developers have been working toward similar capabilities. I built a small model of my own, bekko-system-one-v0, and wanted to see how it compared with other models under the same evaluation conditions. There are many ways to design a more comprehensive evaluation.

sources.title: AIM System One Index - AIMultiple
sources.snippet: AIM System One Index combines each model's scores on AIM-Decision Browser, AIM-Decision Classification and AIM-AI-Bias. Each score becomes a z-score, its distance from the benchmark's average in standard deviations, measured against the models that have all three scores.
